text:
Maya K: Heads up — Novacorp's wire/ACH hit our account but was returned by their bank. Customer says routing/SWIFT was provided by their AP team. Bank returned code: R03 / "Invalid routing number" and message: \"return to sender\". Customer needs clearance to reissue.

Ethan R: Can you drop the payment trace/transaction id and the bank details (redact account numbers)? I want to confirm whether this was ACH or an international wire (SWIFT/IBAN).

Maya K: tx_id: tx_0x7f9a4c (Novacorp-2026-03-02). Bank details from customer (redacted):
Beneficiary: NOVACORP LLC
Bank: First Continental Bank
Routing/SWIFT provided: FCBUS33XXX / 021000021
IBAN: N/A (they said domestic ACH but then mentioned SWIFT...)

Jules (billing-bot): Payment attempt logged: 
- method: ACH
- amount: $48,200.00
- attempted_at: 1713204800
- response_code: R03
- response_text: Invalid routing number (returned)

Priya S: Quick checks we've seen:
- Leading zeros in routing numbers dropped when customers export to Excel/CSV (e.g., 021000021 -> 21000021).
- Confusion between domestic routing vs. SWIFT for international wires.
- Some banks reject ACH and return for domestic routing mismatch.

Priya S: Can you confirm the exact routing string the customer pasted into the invoice/PO? Even one character off will cause R03. Also, did they provide an IBAN for the beneficiary or just domestic routing?

Maya K: Customer pasted: `02100021` (no leading zero). They claim their AP system removed the leading zero. They also attached their PO (PO# NOV-3391) which we need on file.

Ethan R: That matches the classic leading-zero bug. Next steps I suggest:
1) Ask Novacorp AP to reissue the transfer with corrected routing `021000021` OR switch to a wire with correct SWIFT if international.
2) If they need immediate access, offer temporary credit-card payment or manual invoice hold while they reissue.
3) We will mark the attempt as returned and not apply to their outstanding balance.

Maya K: Customer prefers to reissue wire. They want our bank's SWIFT/IBAN for international wire. Can finance confirm our SWIFT and whether we accept international wires or need to use our USD correspondent bank?

Ethan R: We accept both. Our SWIFT is REDWUS44XXX and our USD correspondent routing is 021000021 (same issue). But given their mistake on routing we should provide a short checklist for the AP team to avoid repeats.

Priya S: Operational note: when reprocessing, our payments tool expects full routing including leading zeros. Internal command to re-run reconciliation (for finance ops):
```
payments reconcile --tx tx_0x7f9a4c --status returned --reason "R03 invalid routing" --action hold
payments retry --tx tx_0x7f9a4c --method wire --bank-swift REDWUS44XXX --iban REDWUS44XXX-IBAN --note "Novacorp corrected bank details"
```
(Please redact full account numbers when pasting externally.)

Maya K: I'll forward the checklist and the SWIFT details to Novacorp AP now. Also flagging PO mismatch: their PO references tax-exempt status but we don't have their VAT exemption doc on file. They included a scanned PO but not the tax docs. Do we need legal or finance sign-off before accepting reissued wire with tax exemption?

Ethan R: For domestic US customers tax docs are handled by compliance. For PO + tax-exempt claims, request the exemption cert and attach to the invoice before marking paid. If they insist on immediate processing, we can accept wire but hold final bookkeeping until docs are validated. Escalate to legal only if they refuse to provide documentation.

Maya K: Customer asked for an example email to send to their bank. Drafting and sending now: 
--- email snippet ---
Subject: Reissue payment to Redwood Inference — Corrected routing
Body:
Hi AP team,
Our previous ACH to Redwood (tx_0x7f9a4c) was returned due to a missing leading zero in the routing number. Please reissue payment with the following details:
- Amount: $48,200.00
- Routing (ACH): 021000021
- Bank: First Continental Bank (our correspondent for Redwood)
- Reference/PO: NOV-3391
Please confirm once the transfer is initiated and attach a remittance report.
--- end snippet ---

Priya S: Also ask them to include an ACH trace number on their side once they re-submit. That will speed reconciliation if anything gets returned again.

Jules (billing-bot): Noted — marking attempt tx_0x7f9a4c as `returned_R03` in system.

Ethan R: If they reissue and we still see a return, escalate to bank ops and request the microtrace from their bank. International wires that are misrouted usually show up under returned transfers with an OT return code; we then need the SWIFT trace.

Maya K: I'll follow up with Novacorp and post confirmation here. Thanks, everyone. :thumbsup:

(5 hours later)
Maya K: Update — Novacorp reissued the payment with corrected routing and included remittance + ACH trace 20260302-NV-TRC. Bank confirmed credit pending. Please leave reconciliation off until funds fully clear and tax docs are uploaded.

Ethan R: Got it. Once funds clear I'll post final allocation and close PO NOV-3391. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Priya S: Saved troubleshooting notes for future: include leading-zero warning on invoice templates and add a one-line validation in our payments portal to reject routing numbers <9 digits.

Maya K: Marking resolved for now. Will reopen if bank returns again.
